scan.hold: Hold the card to the card reader
scan.browser: In a web browser, only readers that type the card number like a keyboard work. For a reader like the ACR122U, use the Windows app or a phone with NFC.

problems.required: Hold the card to the reader or type its number.
problems.invalid: This isn't a card number. Hold the card to the reader again or check the number.

holder.stolen: This card was reported stolen and is blocked.

give.title: Give {{name}} a card
give.description: As soon as the card is read, the member gets it.

replace.title: Replace {{name}}'s card
replace.description: The old card stops working at once, and the new card is given in the same step.
replace.reasonMissing: Choose what happened to the card.
replace.stolenHint: A stolen card is blocked, so nobody can use it or be given it.

return.title: Take back {{name}}'s card?
return.description: The card stops working for this member and can be given to someone else.

block.title: Block this card?
block.description: It is given to nobody until it is unblocked.
block.descriptionActive: The card stops working at once, and it is given to nobody until it is unblocked.

unblock.title: Unblock this card?
unblock.description: It can be given to a member again, but it doesn't start working for anyone automatically.

reader.title: Card reader
reader.description: This device's card reader. These settings apply to this device only.
reader.testHint: Hold a card to the reader to see the number it reads and whose card it is.
reader.notACard: The reader typed this, which isn't a card number:
reader.nobody: This card doesn't belong to any member now.
reader.byteOrderHint: Some readers that type like a keyboard type the number backwards. If the same card shows a different number here than on another reader, choose “Reversed”.
reader.managerOnly: Only staff who can manage devices can change this.

pcsc.title: Connected readers
pcsc.description: Readers like the ACR122U, connected to this device by USB.
pcsc.noneHint: Connect the reader by USB. If it doesn't appear, install its driver.
pcsc.liftHint: A card left on the reader isn't read again. Lift it and put it back.

errors.card_in_use: This card is already a member's card.
errors.card_blocked: This card is blocked, so nobody can be given it until a manager unblocks it.
errors.member_has_card: This member already has a card. Replace their card instead.
errors.card_not_found: This card was not found, or you can't see it.
errors.card_reassigned: This card was given to someone else later. Block it from that member's page.
errors.same_card: This is the old card itself. Hold another card to the reader.
errors.member_archived: This member is archived. Reactivate them first.
errors.member_not_found: This member was not found, or you can't see them.
errors.permission_denied: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.gym_read_only: This gym is view-only, so no cards can be given or changed.
errors.invalid_request: These details are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again. If it keeps happening, contact Click Group.

anywhere.unsaved: This page has changes that aren't saved yet, so the member's page wasn't opened.
